newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends shade up on physical buying.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends shade up on physical buying.

text.p: Hong Kong gold edged up slightly on Monday from New York's Friday close on small amounts of physical buying, but gold dealers said the market would remain comatose until after the New Year holiday on Wednesday.
Bullion ended at US$369.40/90 an ounce against New York's US$369.30/369.60 close on Friday.
"Actually there was some physical buying," said a senior bullion dealer at an international bank.
"Nobody is going to do anything until after the New Year," another source said.
Local gold ended HK$1 lower at HK$3,413 a tael.
Tael gold was trading at a slight premium over spot gold, with the U.S. dollar equivalent at $369.80/370.30 per ounce.
The carryover charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society fell to -4.00 from its previous fix at -3.00.
